slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one fighter jet produce per year when it is allocated to training, and is this rate the same in year 1 and year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked for the per-jet annual pilot training capacity, directly covering H1.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or about the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a jet allocated to training in year 1 continue to be used for training in year 2, or must each year's training jets be drawn exclusively from that year's new production?
slot_scores.rationale: The question touches the training timeline and cross-year reuse, but it does not explicitly ask when training starts or how many years the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training occurs in both Year 1 and Year 2, and pilots trained in Year 1 count toward the total available by the end of Year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the training start year or duration; Turn 4 only asked about jet carry-over, and the READY summary did not mark the start/duration assumption as needing confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot was resolved, but the P1 training timeline/duration slot was only partially addressed and remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the critical per-jet training capacity and clarified several boundaries, but it did not ask about the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping and only partially addressed training start/duration before stopping, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
